mode: web-e2e (Playwright Chromium + WebKit, fresh Vite, VITE_E2E_MODE) + visual/code audit
summary: Fresh-Vite product audit passed 20/20 checks in Chromium and 20/20 in WebKit: 13 active-user portrait routes, legacy settings redirect, onboarding, admin and 4 landscape routes. There was no blank screen, NaN, horizontal overflow, uncaught page error or unexpected console.error. Route coverage now includes day, plan edit, new plan and exercise detail. Two test-first typography waves removed 38 sub-11 px labels from the ten highest-risk workout/history/plan/profile/analytics/Strava surfaces; 74 occurrences remain in 46 lower-priority production files. Personalization remains 11 single accents, while a concrete, privacy-safe three-palette plan is documented but not implemented.

orange.title: The semantic typography migration is not complete
orange.evidence: Two test-first waves removed 38 occurrences from ten priority surfaces; 74 occurrences of 8-10.5 px remain across 46 production files. All audited routes still render without overflow or runtime errors at 390x844 and selected landscape views.
orange.suggestion: Continue the documented screen-by-screen migration and prove reflow on physical iOS/Android at 100/150/200% text scale before public release.

orange.title: Avatar personalization is an accent picker, not a three-color palette system
orange.evidence: accent-theme.ts defines 11 independent accents and applies one hue to primary/ring/accent; avatar-accent.ts ranks existing accent IDs. The research plan now specifies Pulse, Forge and Glacier presets, a versioned data contract, local avatar proposal, lossless legacy migration and contrast/privacy acceptance tests, but runtime behavior has not changed.
orange.suggestion: Implement the documented PaletteThemeV2 in a separate test-first wave after release blockers, preserving every existing accent/custom hex until explicit user selection.

yellow.title: Some root routes repeat context in the top bar and page heading
yellow.suggestion: Keep one screen title and use the second line for context or an action in a post-blocker UX cleanup.

fixed_during_audit: Expanded the canonical route contract from 8 to 12 paths and the data-state sweep from 143 to 195 renders.
Added day, plan edit, new plan and exercise detail to the browser audit; all four pass in Chromium and WebKit.

Raised 38 critical labels from 8-10.5 px to 11 px across WorkoutDay, ExerciseCard, CycleTile, HistorySessionRow, TrainingPlan, TrainingDayCard, Profile, AnalyticsChartsTab, StravaActivityCard and MonthlyActivities.
Added two static typography contracts and preserved existing workout/data flows.
native_not_covered: safe-area/notch and real WKWebView overlay lifecycle

Continue the semantic typography migration and physical 100/150/200% text-scale QA.
Implement the documented Pulse/Forge/Glacier PaletteThemeV2 only after release blockers, with lossless legacy migration.
